text:
maria.chen: Heads up — trying to publish py/ts SDKs for v2.4.0 during today's quiet window. I got a signer mismatch on one wheel.
eli: which package? link?
maria.chen: package @redwood/sdk-ts and redwood_sdk_py wheel. publish-bot shows signature mismatch for py wheel only.
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1739009999 by maria.chen
deploy-bot: outcome: partial-fail (py wheel signature mismatch), npm package published
jamal: could be the new signing key rotation. We rolled keys yesterday for the registry.
tara: if npm succeeded, py failing will break crosslang examples. We should either rollback npm or hold py publish until fix.
maria.chen: I can repack the py wheel with the new signer if we confirm key material. samir, can you confirm KMS rotation finished?
samir: KMS rotation completed 1738998000, yes. But key alias rwd-prod-sign not yet updated in CI secrets for py publish runner.
eli: that explains it. CI used old key when signing wheel, resulting in mismatch with registry public key.
jamal: quick options: 1) republish py wheel with updated secret, 2) yank npm and republish both in lockstep, 3) tag current npm as prerelease and push fix later. Preference for no-yank if possible.
tara: product asked for release notes out by EOD for customers. If we delay, we need to craft a brief deprecation/compat note.
maria.chen: action plan: I'll pause final tag on python until CI secret rotated. jamal, can you push a temporary dist-tag to npm to indicate hold?
jamal: I can add dist-tag v2.4.0-hold to npm package. Doing it now.
jamal: done — v2.4.0-hold tag added
maria.chen: thanks. I'll queue a republish for py after secrets update. ETA ~30m.
samir: updating CI secret now. command run: ```gcloud kms keys versions enable 5 --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/rwd-prod-sign``` and updating runner secret in vault.
eli: once republish succeeds, we should also push coordinated docs + changelog and flip dist-tag from -hold to stable in one step.
tara: also add a short note in release notes: "temporary staging tag used due to signer rotation; stable release will be published once python wheel re-signed." Keep it transparent.
maria.chen: republish attempt 1/1: py build succeeded locally, uploading...
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1739010300 by maria.chen
deploy-bot: outcome: success (py wheel v2.4.0)
jamal: flipping tags now: removing v2.4.0-hold, adding v2.4.0 -> done
eli: quick sanity: smoke example repo installs both packages and runs basic integration? maria can you run quick smoke?
maria.chen: running smoke: ```python -c "import redwood_sdk; print(redwood_sdk.__version__)" && node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk-ts/package.json').version)"``` output: 2.4.0 & 2.4.0
maria.chen: smoke looks good.
tara: drafting the release note blurb and a short deprecation snippet for legacy sync client. PR incoming.
eli: tagging release notes PR and changelog. also add a note in the console's release monitor about the hold tag and resolution.
jamal: reminder: follow-up tomorrow to rotate any remaining CI runners to the new key and audit other pipelines.
samir: putting a checklist in infra: rotate-ci-runners, confirm no other signing pipelines using old alias.
maria.chen: final: publishing completed and release notes PR #845 opened. tagging for docs merge.
eli: thanks everyone. timeout: we avoided a rollback and kept npm live, good call on hold tag. :thumbsup:
